model_scope: single-layer NiI2; local electronic model used for magnetic downfolding and cavity study
notes: The negative Delta is transcribed in this paper's convention. Do not replace it with a positive gap from a different model.
Nearest and third-neighbor rows describe different cluster geometries; do not substitute one row into the other geometry.
Rounded tabulated hoppings are used directly; no extra enforcement of ideal Slater-Koster ratios.
These are not Mou-Winter matrix inputs or bulk optical SHG tensor coefficients.

Literal printed Eq. 10 in electron basis gives SOC energies -lambda (doublet), +lambda/2 (quartet); the prose states the opposite ordering. Electron/hole or sign convention must be clarified; code preserves the printed matrix.
Literal Eq.14 kernels are inversion-even under the electron basis/geometry inversion that preserves H0; resolve physical polarization convention before using them for electric-dipole SHG.
verification: Table 2 and Eqs. 9-14 visually checked in downloaded publisher PDF, pages 6-7.
